name: Fraction addition and subtraction

default.aim: Combine fractions with a common denominator.

build.aim: Use equivalent fractions when one denominator is a multiple of the other.

confidence.aim: Use unrelated denominators and convert mixed numbers before calculating.

add.name: Add fractions
steps: Make the denominators equal if necessary.
Add only the numerators; keep the denominator.
add.check: Reverse the addition or subtraction using equivalent fractions to recover the starting value.

subtract.name: Subtract fractions
subtract.when: The task finds the difference between two fractions.
steps: Make the denominators equal if necessary.
Subtract only the numerators; keep the denominator.
subtract.check: Reverse the addition or subtraction using equivalent fractions to recover the starting value.

equivalent.name: Scale to a common denominator
steps: Choose a common multiple of the denominators.
Multiply each numerator and its denominator by the same scale factor.
equivalent.check: Reverse the addition or subtraction using equivalent fractions to recover the starting value.

mixed.name: Convert mixed numbers
mixed.when: A fraction includes a whole-number part.
steps: Multiply the whole number by the denominator and add the numerator.
Keep the denominator and use the resulting improper fraction.
mixed.check: Reverse the addition or subtraction using equivalent fractions to recover the starting value.

simplify.name: Simplify the final fraction
simplify.when: The numerator and denominator share a factor greater than 1.
steps: Divide both by the same common factor.
Repeat until no common factor greater than 1 remains.
simplify.check: Reverse the addition or subtraction using equivalent fractions to recover the starting value.

build.name: Scale one fraction, then add and simplify
build.question: maths:M15-WEB-DEMO-C2-Q1

answerNote: In exams, include the correct units in your working and final answer (including £ for money). In this app, enter just the number; the answer field shows the required unit.
